title: Tenure Relief on Contract Pricing Agreement Rebate Forfeitures
content:
**Tenure relief — Contract Pricing Agreement rebate forfeiture on early termination**

The tenure relief follows the whole months from the agreement effective date, as the agreement record shows it, to the termination effective date. Whole months between two dates are the difference in calendar months between them, less one when the later date's day of the month is earlier than the earlier date's.

- 30 or more whole months: a tenure relief of 0.1 times the termination period's net rebate.
- At least 18 and fewer than 30 whole months: 0.05 times the termination period's net rebate.
- Fewer than 18 whole months: no tenure relief.

The relief is subtracted from the termination period's net rebate before the forfeiture's floor at 0.00 and its rounding to the cent are applied.

| Whole months (hypothetical) | Relief on a net rebate of 2000.00 |
|---|---|
| 17 | None |
| 18 | 100.00 |
| 29 | 100.00 |
| 30 | 200.00 |

Counting example (hypothetical dates): effective 20 May, termination effective 19 November of the following year — 18 calendar months apart, less one because the 19th is earlier than the 20th, so 17 whole months.
